title: Ratiometric discrimination of Th4+ ions by a fluorogenic quinoline appended phenanthridine sensor and its applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4546-4552
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08840A, Paper

Selin Manoj Kumar, Sathishkumar Munusamy, Saravanan Enbanathan, Sivaranjani Ranganadin, Sathiyanarayanan Kulathu Iyer
A new phenanthridine appended quinoline-based chemoreceptor 5-(5-(quinolin-8-yl)thiophen-2-yl)-tetrahydrodibenzo[a,i]phenanthridine (PHQBA) was successfully synthesized and characterized by 1H, 13C, and HRMS spectral analyses.
